title: Accounts Administrator
company: Capital Outsourcing Group Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Administrator

Join a growing team and play a key role in keeping the finances running smoothly.

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Full-time Permanent Monday-Friday, 40 hrs

We're looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Accounts Administrator to join a busy finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in getting things right and thrives in a role where accuracy, organisation and teamwork really matter.

You'll play an important part in supporting the day-to-day finance function, working across accounts payable, customer accounts, payments, reconciliations and general financial administration.

What you'll be doing

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes
- Reviewing supplier statements and ensuring invoices are received and processed accurately
- Supporting the management and collection of outstanding customer balances
- Setting up new customer and supplier accounts
- Processing employee expenses
- Preparing and making supplier payments
- Handling incoming finance-related queries by phone and email
- Processing payments securely over the phone
- Posting bank transactions using accounting software
- Managing the finance team inbox and ensuring queries are dealt with promptly
- Supporting the release of orders where payment requirements have been met
- Providing general finance administration and support to the wider team
- Taking on additional duties and projects as required

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in a Financial Administrator, Accounts Assistant or similar role
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working with financial information and deadlines
- Confident using accounting systems and Microsoft Office
- Enjoys working in a fast paced and busy environment
- Reliable, proactive and able to manage competing priorities
- A positive team player who is happy to get stuck in

Previous experience using SAP or similar business/accounting systems would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

Why join us?

This is more than a processing role. You'll become an important part of a collaborative finance team and have the opportunity to develop your skills across a broad range of financial activities.

We offer:
- £30, 000 annual salary
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Company pension
- On-site parking
- A supportive team environment
- Opportunities to develop your finance experience

The role

Job title: Accounts Administrator

Salary: £30,000 per annum

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Hours: Monday-Friday, 40 hrs

Working arrangement: Office-based
